cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Fake the Expertise
cards.instruction: Perform expertise so confidently that no one questions you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I'll get your boiler running. I know these controls.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've been adjusting the kitchen timer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Establishing the heating interval. Call the engineer; I'll need someone on the boiler.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He asks what temperature you measured.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell him we're still establishing the baseline. Put him on speaker; I'll ask the questions so he can concentrate on readings.

mechanism: A protects fake technical expertise by treating B accurate corrections as signs of its own successful training.
confusable: Not merely condescending instruction: A reclassifies each exposed error as an advanced method and takes control of the real expert.
comparison: Domestic control identification versus audition tuning competence.
seedUse: D18 timer/boiler/baseline sequence remains, with S05 graded correction used to keep B in a learner role.
